note: Consumable, temporary. Active potion effects survive rebirth (run on their own wall-clock timer, unaffected by the rebirth wipe). Luck stacks additively with the equipped mitt; Speed multiplies stove cook time.

valuePotions.concept: Temporary sell-value multiplier, stacking on top of the permanent rebirth sell-value bonus, same pattern as Luck Potion stacking on the Mitt. Ranks/pricing/multiplier curve TBD once playtesting shows whether it's worth the spend at that point in progression.
valuePotions.modelingNote: Test run (15min assumed duration, flat Luck/Speed-style price curve) showed the $2.56M rank-V-equivalent price pays back in under 30 seconds once a player has 2+ mid-tier stoves running - basically a trivial auto-buy past early game, not a real decision. Value Potion likely needs a price that scales with progression stage (more like the stove/mitt tier pricing) rather than the flat consumable curve Luck/Speed use, or the choice stops being interesting once established.
valuePotions.alsoUndefined: Potion duration was never set for ANY potion type (Luck, Speed, or this one) - needs to be decided regardless of Value Potion's fate.
